validation_detection: latched events after full receptive-field warmup

prefix_negatives.policy: Training-positive crops ending 150..350ms before unchanged keyword_frame; replace confusing-negative slots; baseline RNG unchanged; label0 weight20. Endpoint is an energy proxy, not phone timing.

spec_augment.policy: One mask per enabled axis per training sample; width uniform inclusive 0..maximum; independent RNG; disabled for validation and INT8 calibration

mining_policy: Training-only highest-scoring window per sampled confusing-negative row; baseline RNG preserved; disabled for INT8 calibration
selection: Float continuous validation <=0.5 ambient events/h and <=1% confusing clips per source; then maximize mean source recall. Quantized validation must be recalibrated.
scope: Research candidate. Same v1 evaluation sets are development regressions; real-user acceptance remains unmeasured.
